Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the main bottleneck is the inefficient layout of the central repository. Because the repository is located in a single central spot, workers must travel significant distances to retrieve tools and materials, leading to lost productivity. To improve efficiency, the company should consider decentralizing the storage of tools and materials by placing smaller, localized supply stations closer to the various construction areas. This would reduce travel time and minimize the productivity loss caused by commuting back and forth.
